missions.title: Cognitive Conundrum I
missions.description: UMP45 has received a new task from her employer. For this task, they will need to undergo a new kind of training.

missions.title: Cognitive Conundrum II
missions.description: Cyberwarfare training is going smoothly, but UMP45 finds a message from the past…

missions.title: Cognitive Conundrum III
missions.description: As they dive deeper into the training session, UMP45 unlocks a memory that was sealed in her neural system.

missions.title: Cognitive Conundrum IV
missions.description: A Griffin T-Doll is ensnared in a data trap. The opportunity to put the cyberwarfare training into practice has come.

missions.title: Hyperbolic Function I
missions.description: The search mission has begun. The keen Sangvis forces have also quickly acted in response.

missions.title: Hyperbolic Function II
missions.description: The Sangvis Ringleader unceasingly provokes Squad 404, but UMP45's attention is focused on something else…

missions.title: Hyperbolic Function III
missions.description: UMP45 is not afraid of Sangvis Ferri and decides to go on alone. Meanwhile, Destroyer finally reveals her new form in front of everyone...

missions.title: Hyperbolic Function IV
missions.description: The decisive battle against Destroyer, or rather, Cerberus, has begun!

missions.title: Relative Behavior I
missions.description: UMP45's neural system is under Sangvis intrusion. 404 must collect enough pieces of memories to wake her up before Sangvis succeeds in their attack.

missions.title: Relative Behavior II
missions.description: More and more pieces of 45's memories are being uncovered. Dreamer has also begun remodeling Destroyer for the second time…

missions.title: Relative Behavior III
missions.description: The cyberwarfare battles have left 404 exhausted. Yet at this time, Destroyer shows up in a brand new form!

missions.title: Relative Behavior IV
missions.description: The final battle to escape has begun. Can 404 awaken UMP45, shake off Perfect Form (self-proclaimed) Destroyer, and safely escape?

missions.title: Imaginary Maze
missions.description: According to Helian's broadcast, Griffin forces are in grave danger on the battlefield. UMP45 has decided to help with the retreat - for a price, of course...
